svg.title: 30 registered studies measure bone on GLP-1 drugs; 2 have posted results
svg.desc: Randomized: drug vs placebo or no drug: 12 studies, 0 on tirzepatide, 1 with posted results; Randomized: other comparison (every arm on a GLP-1, etc.): 6 studies, 3 on tirzepatide, 0 with posted results; Single-arm: everyone on the drug: 5 studies, 1 on tirzepatide, 1 with posted results; Observational: records or cohorts: 7 studies, 1 on tirzepatide, 0 with posted results. Jabbit hand review of ClinicalTrials.gov, October 20, 2026. Lower bound.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
